title: wg: virtual-clients-01 L1320 The description omits that the joining emulator client needs...
description:
draft-ietf-mls-virtual-clients (virtual-clients-01), State transfer protocol. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-virtual-clients at 65e960d, L1320.

Text: "- `external_secret` lets other parties perform further external
  commits from this epoch."

Problem: The description omits that the joining emulator client needs external_secret (via external_priv) to process external Commits that others send in this epoch, not only to enable them.

Suggested fix: Reword: 'lets the joining emulator client derive external_priv/external_pub to process external Commits and publish GroupInfo for this epoch.'

Severity: low. Verifier: narrow (The text is not strictly wrong, since holding external_secret lets the joiner publish external_pub and so enables others' external commits. It does omit the joiner's own use of external_priv to process incoming external Commits (RFC 9420 §8.3). This is a clarity fix, not a technical defect.)

From MLS audit workflow wf_581e61f8-b25 (2026-10-21). Not yet reviewed by Mark; nothing posted upstream.
